name: Migrating Settlement
description: The settlement chain provides the nomads with the nucleus of their camp, providing subsistence wealth and ensuring the growth of their tribes.

variants.name: Tribal Tents
variants.short: What may seem squalid is the home to a thousand thousand.
variants.flavour: A semi-nomadic confederation of Arabian tribes, the Tanukhids were for many years foederati of the Eastern Roman Empire - military allies positioned along its eastern frontiers to defend them from the Sassanids and others, such as the belligerent Palmyrene Kingdom. As a result, they moved to wherever their enemies were concentrated, living from the land and by trading livestock with the local settled farmers. The Tanukhids impressive cavalry victories meant the Roman Empire called on them many times for aid; apparently a force of lancers even travelled as far as Constantinople itself to defend the Roman capital against the invading Goths. However, eventually religious divisions led to war, Tanukhid victory and Rome's acquiesence to their terms - the appointment of an Orthodox bishop for their people.

variants.name: Desert Enclave
variants.short: "We have thousands of such caches, and only a few of us know them all."
